topic: Discover a merchant's retail stores with UCP location search and lookup
caption:
AI shopping agents can now discover a merchant’s physical stores.

That’s an interesting shift for Shopify developers: a shopping experience doesn’t always have to end at an online storefront.

Shopify’s UCP location tools let compatible agents search a merchant’s active retail locations and look up selected stores by ID. For a buyer, that can make location-aware shopping experiences more useful. For developers, it introduces a new discovery layer to consider when building commerce agents.

A few details matter:
• Search and lookup serve different purposes: discovering locations versus retrieving known ones.
• These capabilities depend on eligible, active merchant-managed retail locations.
• Location discovery is not the same as a confirmed inventory promise or pickup option. Final availability and fulfillment still need verification.

The bigger opportunity is connecting AI-powered shopping with the realities of physical retail—without making promises the storefront can’t keep.
